premises: A thin HED overlay can be deposited on an elemental Cr coating on Zr-alloy cladding.
The HED overlay reacts with the environment to form a complex boride layer containing Cr, Hf, and Mo.
This boride layer reduces interfacial element transport and improves coating integrity.
The HED overlay provides enhanced protection in both normal subcritical-water and accident-relevant high-temperature steam up to 1200°C for 1000 hours.
